blade.name: BLADE
blade.pitch: THE WAY OF THE BLADE: WIDE STRIKES, PARRIES AND DEADLIER CRITICAL HITS.

shadow.name: SHADOW
shadow.pitch: THE SHADOW ARTS: DASH THROUGH THEIR LINES, CHOKE THEM IN POISON, STRIKE FROM BEHIND.

cleric.name: CLERIC
cleric.pitch: THE CLERIC WAY: MENDING WOUNDS, WARDING FRIENDS, AND TAKING A HEALER'S CARE TO HEART.

ranger.name: RANGER
ranger.pitch: THE RANGER'S CRAFT: A QUICK SHOT FOR ANY HAND, SNARES ON THE TRAIL AND LIGHT FEET.

arcane.name: ARCANE
arcane.pitch: THE ARCANE: SEEKING BOLTS, A STEP THROUGH NOTHING, AND A MIND CLEAR ENOUGH TO CAST AGAIN SOONER.

guardian.name: GUARDIAN
guardian.pitch: THE GUARDIAN'S OATH: A SHIELD WHEN IT MATTERS, A SHOUT THAT DRAWS THE BLOWS, AND FEET THAT DON'T MOVE.
